text: Study Sources 1 to 3.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
‘Earning lots of money does not make you happy at work.’
What are the strengths and weaknesses of the argument supporting this claim?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Respect and praise at work increase job satisfaction.’
How could you test this claim? You may consider the types of information, sources of evidence
or methods you might use.

text: Study Source 3.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify one opinion from Dewi’s statement.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Identify one fact from Rio’s statement.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain why Dewi’s statement may be biased.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Which argument is more convincing, Dewi’s or Rio’s?
Your answer should consider both arguments and you should support your point of view with
their words.
You should also consider:
• the strength of their reasoning and evidence
• their use of language
• the different types of information used.

text: Study Source 4.
The owners of a company want to increase the job satisfaction of their workers.
The following actions are being considered:
• train managers in how to respect and praise workers
• improve health and safety conditions
• give all workers a financial stake in the company.
Which one of these actions would you recommend to the owners, and why?
In your answer, you should:
• state your recommendation
• give reasons and evidence to support your choice
• use the material in the sources and/or any of your own ideas
• consider different arguments and perspectives.
